name: Parfumarija
what: The Grasse-trained owner creates custom perfumes to suit your taste. Ask in the shop or contact them for the process and price.

name: The Workshop (House of Read)
what: A hands-on perfumery class where you blend your own fragrance. Price and times on their site.

name: The Perfume Studio
what: Two-hour session building your own perfume. Your formula is saved so you can reorder it.

name: Orris Labs
what: Guided session choosing from 50+ notes with a perfumer; they keep your formula on file for reorders. Also runs pop-up sessions in Niagara wine country (Trius Winery, Niagara-on-the-Lake, in 2026).

price.note: per guest (C$169 for two), as reported

name: Galimard Studio des Fragrances
what: Compose your own perfume at a perfumer's organ in France's perfume capital, guided by Galimard's team; bottled with your name.

name: The Institute for Art and Olfaction
what: Non-profit running beginner perfume-blending workshops by theme (boozy woods, summer, holidays).
